q: Chemical reactions which involve oxidation as well as reduction processes simultaneously, are known as redox reactions.
e: True. Chemical reactions which involve oxidation as well as reduction processes simultaneously, are known as redox reactions. Redox is electron transfer: oxidation is loss of electrons and reduction is gain of electrons.

q: Chemical reactions which involve oxidation as well as reduction processes sequentially, are known as redox reactions.
e: False. Chemical reactions which involve oxidation as well as reduction processes simultaneously, are known as redox reactions. Redox is electron transfer: oxidation is loss of electrons and reduction is gain of electrons.

q: The separate oxidation and reduction reactions are called half-reactions.
e: True. The separate oxidation and reduction reactions are called half-reactions.

q: Redox reactions require a track of each electron to each atom in chemical reactions.
e: True. Redox reactions require a track of each electron to each atom in chemical reactions. Redox is electron transfer: oxidation is loss of electrons and reduction is gain of electrons.

q: In the combustion of magnesium, magnesium loses electrons and so it is oxidised.
e: True. In the combustion of magnesium, magnesium loses electrons and so it is oxidised.

q: In the combustion of magnesium, oxygen gains electrons and so it is oxidised.
e: False. In the combustion of magnesium, magnesium loses electrons and so it is oxidised. In the combustion of magnesium, oxygen gains electrons and so it is reduced.
